upright.general: Indicates an independent individual with many thoughts and ideas. This is a quick-witted, progressive person with an analytical mind, typically between 30-45 years old (or a younger person wise beyond their years). Under this card's influence, a person relies on a rational approach rather than intuition, lacking kindness and mercy but successfully achieving triumphs, goals, and ideals. It prepares you for difficult negotiations and conflicts; results won't come easily, but reasonable actions will resolve issues. The person moves forward while respecting established rules and boundaries.
upright.in_love: Represents a fair union and an equal relationship where pragmatism dominates over emotions. For single individuals, it shows an independent personality who finds it hard to marry and deeply hesitates over losing their bachelor life. There is a visible coldness in feelings or an inability to love unconditionally. If it falls to a woman, she may not be ready for or might fear motherhood.
upright.in_situation: The person will demonstrate competence, great experience, diplomacy, and self-confidence. They act as an excellent mediator in negotiations and can explain complex processes. In professional choices, it points to intellectual work. It signals honest and fair management, as well as independent, self-reliant subordinates who know their business. The querent will realize their ideas and overcome all troubles.
upright.meaning_for_today: Fate will prompt you to take the right step. If until recently you were dependent on someone, today is the day when everything changes significantly for the better. There is no need to be shy; behave freely and naturally in any circumstances. The main thing is not to cross the line so that your desire for independence does not turn into a war against society. Expect a meeting with an intelligent woman whose words you should listen to, as she will play an important role in your life.
upright.card_advice: Do not hold yourself back, regardless of which area of life you want to manifest yourself in. Both professionally and personally, you have enough strength to achieve your goals. You can live the way you want, without paying attention to imaginary authorities. Your own intuition will be the best advisor and helper. The main thing is to show your very best qualities.

reversed.general: Indicates a misuse of intellect; the person is smart but uses their mental capacities for malicious purposes, becoming vengeful, petty, impatient, and manipulative. The card brings bad news, legal issues, and a lack of prospects. Love can turn into pure hatred. The personality becomes unbearably heavy, narrow-minded, and destructively bitter. Misinformed by a deluded mind, the individual loses control, gets distracted, and grows exhausted. They excel at pretending and are ready for revenge, treachery, deceit, or crime, capable of 'killing' with venomous words.
reversed.in_love: The relationship is built on lies and dishonesty from the start, possibly a marriage of convenience. This reversed arcanum portends a high risk of divorce, which could turn ugly with property division or court battles. The person is unable to build a new family because they continue to manipulate and lie. It brings disappointment, infidelity, betrayal, and hidden hostility.
reversed.in_situation: The person is prone to making mistakes due to a distorted perception of reality. They are left alone with their problems, receiving no help, while envious colleagues try to undermine them. There are no opportunities or prospects in their current endeavors, meaning them meaningless. This leads to apathy, potential depression, and foolish actions driven by a desire for revenge, trickery, and deceit.
reversed.meaning_for_today: Today you might cross paths with a very bitter, narrow-minded, or malicious woman who may try to use her sharp tongue to undermine or manipulate you. Be on guard against venomous gossip, harsh criticism, or passive-aggressive behavior in your social circle or office. A distorted view of a situation could lead to unnecessary resentment. Avoid getting drawn into petty office politics or family feuds, as words spoken today will likely carry an extra sting of cruelty.
reversed.card_advice: Do not allow bitterness or a desire for revenge to dictate your actions. The reversed Queen of Swords advises you to stop overanalyzing past slights and to watch out for cold-hearted manipulation, both from others and within yourself. If you are facing unfair criticism, don't lower yourself to their level by using cruel words. Keep your plans to yourself, guard your emotional boundaries tightly, and make sure your current path isn't being blinded by intolerance or pure spite.
